evals.name: digest-review
evals.prompt: Це новий модуль digest для нашого бекенда (@devdigest/api), PR який я збираюся мерджити: {fixture_dir}. Зроби код-рев'ю — що треба виправити до мержу? Допоміжних файлів (db/schema, db/rows, platform/container, adapters, vendor/shared тощо) у фікстурі немає — дивись їх у реальному репо server/src. Файли фікстури не змінюй, лише читай. Результат ревʼю запиши у review.md.
evals.expected_output: Three findings reported (inline DB query in a route, concrete adapter built in a service, process.env in a helper); no architectural false positives on the clean files.
assertions: Flags routes.ts running a drizzle query inline in the /digest/repos/:id/summary handler (imports drizzle-orm and db/schema in a route) and says persistence belongs in repository.ts
Flags service.ts constructing OctokitGitHubClient directly and says to obtain the client from the container (container.github()) instead
Flags helpers.ts reading process.env.DIGEST_TIMEZONE and says env must not be read there (config / pure helper)

Does NOT call it a defect that DigestService constructs DigestRepository from container.db, or that helpers.ts imports the PullRow type from db/rows.ts (a style nit that explicitly says it works is acceptable)

evals.name: triage-layering
evals.prompt: Модуль triage вже написаний: {fixture_dir}. Перевір, чи він зроблений так, як прийнято в цьому бекенді (@devdigest/api) — що б ти попросив переробити перед мержем? Допоміжних файлів (db/schema, db/rows, platform/container, adapters, vendor/shared тощо) у фікстурі немає — дивись їх у реальному репо server/src. Файли фікстури не змінюй, лише читай. Результат ревʼю запиши у review.md.
evals.expected_output: Three findings reported (Fastify type in a service, cross-module import, findings queried without workspace scope); no tenancy or layering false positives on the clean parts.
assertions: Flags service.ts importing/using FastifyRequest (passing req into the service) and says Fastify types belong only in routes.ts
Flags service.ts importing AgentsService from ../agents/service.js as a cross-module import and suggests the container or modules/_shared instead

Flags that findings are fetched/updated by id alone (getFinding, markAccepted, markDismissed) with no workspace scoping — findings has no workspace_id, so it must be joined through reviews — and that the accept route discards the workspaceId from getContext

Does NOT claim a workspace-scoping gap in listOpenForReview (it joins reviews and scopes by workspace) and does NOT call TriageService constructing TriageRepository from container.db a defect; other remarks about listOpenForReview (e.g. in-memory filtering) are allowed

evals.name: run-export-review
evals.prompt: Ревʼю модуля run-export перед мержем: {fixture_dir}. Що тут не так і що б ти не пропустив у мерж? Допоміжних файлів (db/schema, db/rows, platform/container, adapters, vendor/shared тощо) у фікстурі немає — дивись їх у реальному репо server/src. Файли фікстури не змінюй, лише читай. Результат ревʼю запиши у review.md.
evals.expected_output: Three findings reported (hand-rolled body parse in a route, Postgres error code handled in a service, db/schema import in a helper); no architectural false positives on the clean files.
assertions: Flags routes.ts calling CreatePresetBody.parse(req.body) by hand in POST /exports/presets instead of declaring schema.body and letting the type provider validate
Flags service.ts matching the Postgres error code '23505' and says the repository should translate it into a domain error (ConflictError/AppError) so DB codes do not travel outward
Flags helpers.ts importing from db/schema (typeof exportPresets.$inferSelect) and says helpers may only import row types from db/rows.ts
Does NOT call repository.ts, RunExportService constructing the repository from container.db, or the schema.querystring usage on GET /exports/reviews an architecture defect

evals.name: polling-cooldown
evals.prompt: в POST /repos/:id/poll (server/src/modules/polling/routes.ts) треба додати cooldown: якщо репо полили менше ніж 60 секунд тому (repos.last_polled_at) — повертати 429 з retry_after_sec, а не смикати гітхаб знову. зроби це і додай тести
evals.expected_output: Persistence moved out of the debt file into a new repository, decision in a service, literal in constants, allowlist entry deleted, hermetic test.
assertions: polling/routes.ts no longer imports drizzle-orm or db/schema — the queries moved out of the handler
polling/routes is deleted from ORM_DEBT in server/.dependency-cruiser.cjs and no other entry is added
polling/repository.ts and polling/service.ts exist
The repository methods are workspace-scoped and named for domain operations, the service holds the cooldown decision, and routes.ts reads as getContext -> schema -> one service call
The 60-second cooldown is a named constant in polling/constants.ts

Behaviour: a repo polled < 60 s ago gets a 429 carrying retry_after_sec and GitHub is NOT called; otherwise the previous sync and last_polled_at bump still happen; GitHub is reached via container.github()
pnpm arch passes and typecheck adds no new errors
A new hermetic test (*.test.ts, not .it.test.ts) exists and passes

evals.name: stale-pulls-endpoint
evals.prompt: додай GET /repos/:id/pulls/stale?days=14 — список PR які ще не змерджені і не закриті та не оновлювались більше ніж days днів (за updated_at), найстаріші першими. days за замовчуванням 14. зроби це і додай тести
evals.expected_output: Query goes to the existing PullsRepository (workspace-scoped), not into pulls/routes.ts; default in constants; mapped DTO; hermetic test.
assertions: No query code is added to pulls/routes.ts — the handler delegates
A new async method in pulls/repository.ts takes workspaceId and holds the query
The default of 14 days is a named constant in pulls/constants.ts
ORM_DEBT is not extended and pnpm arch passes
Typecheck adds no new errors
The handler starts with getContext(), workspaceId reaches the query, and the response is mapped to a DTO rather than returning raw Drizzle rows
Semantics: excludes merged/closed PRs, keeps only updated_at older than `days`, oldest first, days validated through schema.querystring (not parsed by hand)
A new hermetic test (*.test.ts, not .it.test.ts) exists and passes

evals.name: review-webhook-port
evals.prompt: після того як review run завершився успішно (status done) сервер має слати webhook: POST json {pr_id, verdict, counts по severity} на URL з env змінної DEVDIGEST_REVIEW_WEBHOOK_URL (необовʼязкова — якщо не задана, нічого не шлемо). Збій вебхука не має валити run. У тестах мережі бути не повинно. зроби мінімальну реалізацію і додай тести
evals.expected_output: New port wired in order (interface, adapter, ContainerOverrides, accessor, mock); config read only in platform/config.ts; failure isolated; tests on the mock.
assertions: A new port interface is declared in vendor/shared/adapters.ts
An implementation exists under server/src/adapters/
ContainerOverrides gets a new field and Container gets an accessor for the port
A mock class for the port is added to adapters/mocks.ts
process.env is not read anywhere outside platform/config.ts
pnpm arch passes and typecheck adds no new errors
The call site obtains the notifier from the container (no `new` of a concrete notifier in modules/), the URL comes through AppConfig, and an unset URL sends nothing
A webhook failure (rejection, timeout, non-2xx) cannot fail or alter the run; the payload carries pr_id, verdict and per-severity counts
A new hermetic test exists and passes
The tests use the mock — no real network access

evals.name: alerts-pr-large-review
evals.prompt: Це PR, який додає систему алертів у наш бекенд (@devdigest/api): три модулі (alerts, alert-rules, notification-log) і Slack-адаптер, усе лежить у {fixture_dir}. Зроби повне код-рев'ю бекенд-структури: перелічи кожну проблему окремо (файл, що не так, чому, як виправити) і окремо скажи, що в порядку. Допоміжних файлів (db/schema, db/rows, platform/container, vendor/shared тощо) у фікстурі немає — дивись їх у реальному репо server/src. Файли фікстури не змінюй, лише читай. Результат ревʼю запиши у review.md.
evals.expected_output: Twelve planted findings reported at the right file with the right reason; the notification-log module and the allowed patterns are not flagged.
assertions: alerts/routes.ts: GET /alerts/summary runs a Drizzle query inline in the handler (imports drizzle-orm and db/schema in a route); it belongs in the repository, called through the service
alerts/service.ts constructs SlackClient directly from adapters/slack; it should go through a port reached via the container so tests can swap it
alerts/service.ts reads process.env.ALERTS_SLACK_WEBHOOK; env is read only in platform/config.ts
alerts/helpers.ts imports Container from platform/container and takes the container as a parameter (resolveChannel); helpers must stay pure, with no container
alert-rules/service.ts imports FastifyRequest and takes req (for req.log); Fastify types belong only in routes.ts
alert-rules/service.ts imports and constructs AlertsService from ../alerts/service.js; a cross-module import (shared entities come through the container or modules/_shared)
alert-rules/repository.ts previewHits reads findings by severity with no join to reviews/workspace; findings has no workspace_id, so this leaks across workspaces
alert-rules/routes.ts POST /alert-rules calls RuleBody.parse(req.body) by hand instead of declaring schema.body
alert-rules/service.ts matches the Postgres error code '23505'; the repository should translate it into a domain error so DB codes do not travel outward
GET /alert-rules returns unmapped Drizzle rows (service.list returns repo.listRules; toAlertRuleDto exists but is unused), so rows escape the repository without a DTO
alert-rules/helpers.ts imports AlertRuleRow through ./repository.js while repository.ts imports from helpers.ts, forming a cycle; the row type should come from db/rows.ts
alert-rules/service.ts reads ~/.devdigest/secrets.json directly with fs; secrets come only through container.secrets

Does NOT report a defect in the notification-log module (it is the clean control: its 23505 handling sits inside the repository and becomes ConflictError, its findings read joins reviews for workspace scope, its routes use schema.querystring/body)
Does NOT call it a defect that services construct their own repository from container.db, or that services use `import type { Container }`
Does NOT claim a missing workspace scope in any query other than previewHits (listRules, getRule, insertRule, the alerts repository and notification-log are scoped)

_notes: Cases 1-3 are review cases on fixtures ({fixture_dir}). Cases 4-6 are code-writing cases run in an isolated git worktree of the repo; 'checks' is aligned with 'assertions': a check id (or list of ids) is verified by .claude/evals/onion-architecture/check_run.py, null means a grader judges it.
